items.source: This method can be especially useful when working with method references. It allows you to easily convert a method that throws a checked exception into an instance compatible with a regular Function.
items.translation: 此方法在处理方法引用时特别有用。它允许您将抛出受检异常的方法轻松转换为与常规 Function 兼容的实例。

items.source: Return a new ThrowingFunction where the apply(Object) method wraps any thrown checked exceptions using the given exceptionWrapper.
items.translation: 返回一个新的ThrowingFunction，其中apply(Object)方法使用给定的exceptionWrapper包装任何抛出的受检异常。

items.source: Lambda friendly convenience method that can be used to create a ThrowingFunction where the apply(Object) method wraps any thrown checked exceptions using the given exceptionWrapper.
items.translation: Lambda 友好的便捷方法，可用于创建 `ThrowingFunction`，其中 `apply(Object)` 方法使用给定的 `exceptionWrapper` 包装任何抛出的受检异常。

items.source: Default Function.apply(Object) that wraps any thrown checked exceptions (by default in a RuntimeException).
items.translation: 默认情况下，Function.apply(Object) 会包装任何抛出的受检异常（默认情况下包装为 RuntimeException）。

items.source: Lambda friendly convenience method that can be used to create a ThrowingFunction where the apply(Object) method wraps any checked exception thrown by the supplied lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: Lambda 友好的便捷方法，可用于创建ThrowingFunction，其中apply(Object)方法会包装由提供的 Lambda 表达式或方法引用抛出的任何受检异常。

items.source: Applies this function to the given argument, wrapping any thrown checked exceptions using the given exceptionWrapper.
items.translation: 将此函数应用于给定参数，并使用给定的 `<code>exceptionWrapper` 包装任何抛出的受检异常。
